assertions.source: Ocneanu route re-exam completed at 50 dps.

description: Re-examines commit 6766b40b9's correction of the Ocneanu −1/12 attribution for the proton-mass-identity '12'. Confirms the Borromean pole-order claim (pole 4, leading -1) but finds the empirical k = 12.0xx is tighter than the audit's 'empirical integer near-match' phrasing suggests, deserving deeper categorical investigation. Several natural candidates (4·3 edge cells, Σd_λ²·2, 3!·[2]_q-at-1) all give 12 EXACTLY.

data.verdict: AUDIT VERDICT STANDS but with NUANCE: the empirical k ≈ 12 is extraordinarily close to integer 12 (~10⁻⁴ relative). The correction commit was right that the Borromean's pole structure doesn't give -1/12 — but the integer 12 itself is so tight (10⁻⁴) that it deserves a NEW structural explanation, not just 'empirical near-match.' Several natural candidates (4·3 = #edge cells × #strands; Σd_λ²·2 = 6·2; 3!·[2]_q at q=1 = 12) hit exactly 12 — deserves categorical investigation.
